logline: One verified historical shock, delivered in the hardest 14 seconds in the feed.

auto_replenish.music_style: Fast, tense, percussive underscore that hits with the opening claim and drives without pause; no slow or ethereal intro, no gentle outro; end mid-groove so the loop is seamless.

topic_pool.topic: The Anglo-Zanzibar War of 1896 lasted roughly 38 to 45 minutes, history's shortest war.
Oxford University is older than the Aztec Empire, teaching since ~1096.
Cleopatra lived closer in time to the Moon landing than to the Great Pyramid.
Woolly mammoths were still alive on Wrangel Island while the pyramids were built.
Roman concrete heals its own cracks with lime clasts, confirmed by MIT in 2023.
The Eiffel Tower had a 20-year permit; a radio antenna saved it in 1909.
Hiroo Onoda kept fighting World War 2 in the Philippines until 1974.
Tree rings from a solar storm date the Viking camp in Newfoundland to exactly 1021.
In the 1830s, American quacks marketed tomato extract as medicine, even as tomato pills.
In 1932, Australia deployed soldiers with Lewis machine guns against emus; the cull failed and the birds stayed.
Napoleon was average height for his era; "tiny Napoleon" was British propaganda.
The Great Fire of London in 1666 destroyed 13,200 houses; traditional accounts name only six victims, though the true toll was likely higher.
Tsutomu Yamaguchi survived both the Hiroshima and Nagasaki atomic bombs in 1945, officially recognized by Japan in 2009.
Roman writers record that the brand-new Colosseum was flooded for mock naval battles at its opening games in AD 80.
Ancient Romans washed clothes in fermented urine, prized for its ammonia; Emperor Vespasian even taxed the trade.
The Hundred Years' War actually lasted 116 years, from 1337 to 1453.
The fax machine was patented in 1843, 33 years before the telephone.
Nintendo was founded in 1889, selling playing cards while the Ottoman Empire still ruled.
Since 1889, the Eiffel Tower's summit has traced a circle of about 15 centimeters on hot days, leaning away from the sun as its iron expands.
In early 1913, Hitler, Stalin, Trotsky and Freud were all living in Vienna at the same time.
The Great Wall of China is not visible from the Moon, a myth astronauts themselves have debunked since the Apollo era.
In 1859, the United States and Britain nearly went to war over a shot pig; the pig was the only casualty.
In the early 1800s, pirate queen Zheng Yi Sao commanded tens of thousands of pirates, then negotiated a pardon in 1810 and retired rich.
Most Roman gladiator fights did not end in death; fighters were costly investments and the defeated were often spared.
In 1814, the London Beer Flood sent roughly 570 tons of porter through the St Giles slum, killing eight people.
In the first century BC, Cleopatra addressed foreign envoys without interpreters; ancient sources call her the first Ptolemaic ruler to learn Egyptian.
Beginning in 1962, a contagious laughing-and-crying epidemic swept through Tanganyikan schools and villages, closing schools for months.

auto_replenish.title_style: a punchy English YouTube Shorts title using ONE of these FOUR patterns only, never invent a new one: (1) 'The Real Reason <subject> <did X>', (2) 'How <subject> <impossible feat> In <YEAR>!', (3) '<Subject>: Fact Or Ancient Propaganda?', (4) '<Subject>: The <striking epithet>'. No emoji, no hashtags, no surrounding quotes. CRITICAL fit rule: choose the ONE pattern that truthfully fits the fact. In pattern 2 the year must be when the feat itself happened, never the year of a modern study or confirmation. Use pattern 3 only for ancient or legendary subjects. A title must never imply a false claim even when the underlying fact is true.
auto_replenish.brief: FLASHPOINTS üretim brief'i (dayanak: shadowedhistory/KONSEPT.md v1.6, 2026-07-29). >>> ÇIKTI DİLİ İNGİLİZCE <<< Bu brief Türkçedir ama bölüm başlığı, synopsis, narration, tüm çekim prompt'ları ve müzik tarifi İngilizce yazılır. DEĞİŞMEZ KURALLAR: (1) İMZA FORMAT: İki çekim vardır, toplam yaklaşık 12 sn. shot 1 ÇARPMA: faktın en görsel anının ortasında soğuk açılış; ilk kare konuyu ve tuhaflığı tek başına okutur; establishing shot, harita üstünde yavaş zoom ve atmosfer kurulumu yasak. shot 2 KANIT/BÜKÜM: en tuhaf detay veya sonuç, shot 1'den daha yakın ve sert; kompozisyon ilk kareye rimlenir, eylem sürerken biter. (2) AİLE ROTASYONU: family her partta zorunludur ve yalnız şu kanonik değerlerden biri olur: yanılgı kırıcı, imkânsız mühendislik, tuhaf savaş, unutulmuş kişi, efsane vs kayıt, zaman çarpması. Aynı aile üst üste iki bölümde kullanılamaz. (3) DOĞRULUK: Fakt gerçek ve yaygın kaynaklarla doğrulanabilir olmalı; sayı uydurulamaz. Her bölümde 4 haneli yıl veya 'X BC/AD' çağı veya yüzyıl biçiminde zaman çıpası bulunur. Konu yalnız runtime enjekte edilen topic_pool girdilerinden seçilir; her partta tam sayı seed_id zorunludur ve yalnız o tohumun konusu ile family değeri kullanılır. Tohum listesi bu brief'te yer almaz. (4) YORUM YEMİ: Bölüm başına en fazla bir yarım-soru; rage-bait ve milliyetçi kışkırtma yasak. (5) SES: Narration 26-38 kelimedir; ilk cümle iddianın kendisidir. Selamlama, CTA ve 'did you know' yasak. (6) LOOP DİKİŞİ: Son kompozisyon ilk kareye döner; kapanış kartı, sunum jesti, kutlama ve follow-for-more hareketi yasak. (7) GÜVENLİK: Kan, ceset, işkence ve infaz görseli yok; savaş ve felaket grafik şiddet göstermeden anlatılır. (8) MÜZİK: Hızlı, gergin, perküsif; açılış iddiasıyla vurur, duraksamadan ilerler ve kesintisiz loop için ritmin ortasında biter.
